description: This file defines a JavaScript object named 'Datetimecombo' that handles rendering and manipulating date-time input fields for certain forms in a CRM system. It includes methods for generating HTML select elements for hours, minutes, and meridiem, updating the date-time value based on user input, and generating scripts for updating calendar widgets. The file serves as a utility component for date-time field rendering and interaction, primarily used in edit views of call, meetings, and task modules.

classes.name: Datetimecombo
classes.description: A JavaScript constructor function for handling rendering and interaction of date-time fields within the CRM's JavaScript frontend.

methods.name: jsscript(callback)
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript function string for updating the date-time input based on calendar widget interactions.

methods.name: html(callback)
methods.description: Renders the HTML form elements (select dropdowns and checkboxes) used for the date-time input.

methods.name: update(updateListeners)
methods.description: Handles change events on the input elements to update the combined date-time string and manage UI states.
